summary: Source-anchored research for Terraform mongodbatlas_advanced_cluster per-shard replication_specs migration. Run status: COMPLETED.

facts.text: If migration accompanies conversion from REPLICASET to a multi-shard cluster, first apply SHARDED with one shard, restart application clients to reconnect, then add shards. The guide warns that skipping client reconnection can cause inconsistent data or application outages. (low confidence)

The converter supports dynamic replication_specs and region_configs when for_each evaluates to a list of objects; maps and sets are unsupported. Mixing individual blocks with dynamic blocks for either field requires restructuring, for example with a concatenated local list. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-30)

Provider 1.18.0 deprecated num_shards and introduced independent replication_specs objects. Provider 2.0.0 removed num_shards and supports only the new sharding configuration. The v2 data sources also removed use_replication_spec_per_shard and always return the new representation. (low confidence) Sources: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/terraform-provider-mongodbatlas/master/CHANGELOG.md ; https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/terraform-provider-mongodbatlas/master/docs/guides/migrate-to-advanced-cluster-2.0.md

MongoDB instructs users to back up Terraform state before migration, remove deprecated attributes and references, and revise configuration until the plan has no changes. Apply even an empty plan to persist the upgraded state format; the previous state format is no longer supported. (low confidence)

Under the new sharding schema, shard count equals the number of replication_specs elements. Replace a legacy num_shards = N specification with N per-shard elements preserving its regional configuration; num_shards was deprecated in provider 1.18.0 and removed in 2.0.0. (high confidence) Sources: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/terraform-provider-mongodbatlas/master/docs/guides/advanced-cluster-new-sharding-schema.md ; https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/terraform-provider-mongodbatlas/master/docs/guides/migrate-to-advanced-cluster-2.0.md

PR #2525 documents a historical expected 500 error during the independent-shard migration and was merged August 26, 2024. Its reviewed warning scoped Atlas UI editing restrictions to early September 2024; this is not evidence of an ongoing 2026 outage. (low confidence) (verified as of 2024-08-26)

The new sharding schema represents each shard with one replication_specs element. Replace num_shards=N with N corresponding elements while preserving their region configuration; remove num_shards in the same edit. For GEOSHARDED clusters, preserve the zone_name on each replicated element. (low confidence)

The v2 migration also converts replication_specs and region_configs blocks into list attributes, and electable_specs and other single nested blocks into object attributes. References to former single-block values must drop their [0] index. Merely duplicating old HCL blocks does not complete the v2 syntax migration. (low confidence)

A successful plan does not prove removed nested fields were cleaned up. The migration guide warns that Terraform may silently accept removed nested attributes; a HashiCorp maintainer explains that Terraform filters extra object attributes before sending configuration to the provider. Manually inspect removed fields such as num_shards. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-30) Sources: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/terraform-provider-mongodbatlas/master/docs/guides/migrate-to-advanced-cluster-2.0.md ; https://github.com/hashicorp/terraform-plugin-framework/issues/1210

The Atlas CLI Terraform plugin offers atlas terraform advancedClusterToV2 --file in.tf --output out.tf to generate v2 configuration. Its documented limitations include mixing dynamic and individual replication_specs or region_configs blocks; review generated output and the migration plan. (low confidence)

The new-sharding guide warns that an imported legacy cluster, a configuration predating provider 1.23.0, or a direct v1-to-v2 upgrade without a cluster update may still lack shard-level auto-scaling. It says a configuration update is needed to activate it; the per-shard representation alone is insufficient. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-30)

Provider 2.0 changes replication_specs and region_configs from nested blocks to list attributes, and electable_specs to an object attribute. Root disk_size_gb is removed; the migration examples place disk size inside node specifications. (high confidence)
An existing one-replication_specs-per-shard configuration using v1 block syntax still needs the v2 attribute-syntax migration. It does not need to expand shard count again. (low confidence)

OpenTofu independently documents that conversion to an object type discards extra keys. For migration reviews this supports checking typed module inputs for lost attributes; it is language behavior evidence, not an independent Atlas migration test. (low confidence)

The Atlas CLI converter command is atlas terraform advancedClusterToV2 --file in.tf --output out.tf, with alias atlas tf adv2v2 -f in.tf -o out.tf. Review its generated configuration before applying. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-30)
